12/05/2024 edited: I add a new image up there in the preview section of my file paths.
Here's a breakdown of the steps:
1) Install required mods (SMAPI, Content Patcher, [b]Portraiture[/b])
2) [b]Create a new folder[/b] in the 'Portraits' folder of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture mod
[/url][i]...for example, if you named your new created folder '[b]new folder[/b]', it should be like: Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\[/i][i]new folder
[/i]...btw my new folder is named VERSION 1 in the preview images up there.
3) Download the rar file of this mod (which contains 3 png), and placed them in the [b]new folder [/b]mentioned in step 2.
4) "Press P to change Portrait-Set when the DialogBox is open." - in other words, In game, talk to anyone and [b]Press P[/b] to change the portrait set/folders.


Also, Check [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25154] My other Seb Portrait mod[/url] if you had some not-so-innocent Seb dialogue mod 😏, so his sly grin and blushing face are more in character.
This mod is for a more family-friendly precious vanilla Seb.

Downloads.Description: include 3 png for 1.6 vanilla Sebastian Portrait, normal, winter, beach.
